title: A Living System: source-first publication
content: This publication treats the document as a **versioned knowledge artifact**. Its rendered PDF is a stable reading surface; its typed source ledger, LaTeX manuscript, and editorial companion are the evolving source system. Every published revision is reproducible from its recorded inputs.
margin: Snapshot is not the source of truth; the append-only source ledger is.

title: Memory Fabric and provenance
content: The Memory Fabric progression is **quarantine → provenance → graph → promotion → ledger**. In this publication, candidate blocks begin untrusted, retain source and author metadata, are linked to related concepts, and become accepted content only after review. The editorial interface is not an authorization boundary: private memory records, credentials, and session material do not belong in public blocks.
margin: Quarantine before promotion; provenance before trust.

title: Measured runtime and capability states
content: A visible subsystem must distinguish **AVAILABLE**, **ACTIVE**, **DEGRADED**, and **UNSUPPORTED**. A label is not telemetry. A feature is ACTIVE only when a real operation and its evidence are available; a roadmap node or provider homepage does not prove a connected account, deployment, or running service. The publication applies this distinction to its own build and editorial features.
margin: No decorative active states: require an observable operation.

title: Time-bounded phase accumulation
explanation: The source blueprint describes an unbounded authoritative phase accumulator; any wrapped phase is a separate display projection. This equation is included as a project-specific computational model, not as a result established by the AlphaXiv candidates.
margin: Keep authoritative state separate from its display projection.

title: AlphaXiv evidence and review gate
content: The current AlphaXiv ledger contains five candidate references spanning QC-LDPC construction, non-binary LDPC for storage, blockchain consensus surveys, adaptive CRC/QC-LDPC selection, and Reed–Solomon list decoding. Each is a discovery pointer, not an approved standard. A reviewer must record the exact proposition used, assumptions, limitations, reproducibility notes, linked implementation or test, and disposition before a claim is promoted.
margin: A citation establishes provenance, not implementation correctness.
